A.name: Search Box → Text Results
A.description: User types a keyword in a search box; results appear as a list of text items (no table). Common on Know Your Standards portal.
A.realBisExample: standards.bis.gov.in — search by product name or IS number

B.name: Directory → Direct PDF Links
B.description: A page lists PDF documents as direct download links in a directory layout. No search required — scrape and download each link.
B.realBisExample: bis.gov.in — Certification Process guidelines PDF list

C.name: Static Table (with optional filter)
C.description: A full data table is displayed on page load. Optional search box filters visible rows. Used for certification lists and compulsory products.

D.name: Search → Table → PDF in Last Column
D.description: User searches by IS number; results appear in a table; last column has View/Download PDF links. Most common BIS document pattern.
D.realBisExample: bis.gov.in — Product Manuals table with download

E.name: Login → Search → Results
E.description: Requires authentication first (login + captcha), then search on a protected page. Proves Playwright can handle gated portals.

F.name: Detail Page → Metadata + PDF
F.description: Navigate to a standard detail page (via search or direct URL), scrape metadata tabs, and download linked PDF.
F.queryLabel: IS number for detail page (e.g. IS 623:2025)
F.realBisExample: standards.bis.gov.in — Standard Details with tabs and manual PDF

G.name: News list (all items, no search)
G.description: Public news page lists all announcements. Scrape every card — no keyword required.

N.name: Login → org dashboard
N.description: Authenticate on eBIS then scrape the logged-in dashboard as an org-session probe.
